notes_for_editor: Only the register, the undated Mass.gov list and the 2015 chapter report were read. No source after 2015 covers condition, access or staffing. Height 19.8 m is converted from the register's 65 ft. The brief's 2015 'restored' event is supported by the chapter report's 'complete tower cab replacement and rebuild'. Search snippets giving a 68-foot height and a state tower number were not fetchable and are not used. Fact-check 2026-10-08: the 2015 chapter report does name Dennis, but only for the cab rebuild; it does not say which towers were staffed, so the earlier '(Dennis not named)' note was wrong and is corrected above.
